description: Run a policy-rate spread what-if scenario for an FX pair and estimate directional spot impact using an explicit heuristic elasticity assumption. Access: keyless: subscription_required with a subscribe link.

base.description: Base currency, 3-letter ISO code (case-insensitive). Supported: lowercase 3-letter catalogue currency, e.g. usd or eur.

elasticity_per_100bps.description: Heuristic percent change in FX spot for a 100 bps spread change. Used as a scenario assumption, not a forecast guarantee.

policy_shock_bps.description: Optional alias for shock_bps for compatibility with host-side app payloads.

quote.description: Quote currency, 3-letter ISO code (case-insensitive). Supported: lowercase 3-letter catalogue currency, e.g. usd or eur.

shock_bps.description: Policy shock size in basis points (100 bps = 1.00 percentage point).

shock_leg.description: Which leg receives the policy shock: base or quote.

name: policy_scenario_modeler_task
title: Policy Scenario Modeler Task
